title: Map of reported flying object sightings in the US as of 1 August 1948 (Appendix B)
description: Map of the United States and southern Canada, printed sideways, with symbols marking reported sightings concentrated in the Pacific Northwest, California, the Midwest and the East Coast. The inset legend, titled "Reported Sightings of Flying Objects as of 1 August 1948", distinguishes disks, cigar shapes, balls of fire, cones of fire and configuration undetermined. Side heading reads "APPENDIX 'B' — REPORTED SIGHTINGS OF FLYING OBJECTS AS OF 1 AUGUST 1948"; stamped CONFIDENTIAL.
